title: Design System: Leonardo Carvalho, fourth edition

ink-3.note: Alpha of ink over the ground; the third text voice: the clock place name, the scroll arrow, footers, index numerals at rest.

hair.note: Every divider. Rises to 25% under prefers-contrast: more.

well.note: Row hover wash, interest wells, default tile ground.

wash-green.note: Light only: mixed at 36% and 14% into the wash behind an opened experiment. Never a fill.

wash-violet.note: Light only: mixed at 36% and 14% into the wash behind an opened experiment. Never a fill.

shadows.name: object
shadows.purpose: The one shadow of the system (--shadow): under drawn devices, the white page, row previews.

shadows.name: window-ring
shadows.purpose: The window's outer ring. Not reused.

shadows.name: window-frame
shadows.purpose: The window's inner glass frame. Not reused.

shadows.name: dot-glow
shadows.purpose: The window's three dots and the current tab's bar.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: An interest well while lifted under the pointer, and only then.

shadows.name: small-lifts
shadows.purpose: Small objects over a surface; recorded as built, not a scale to extend.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Site ease for geometry: reveals, settles, leans, openings, page changes.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: translate 0 28px (rows 12px, wells 16px) to none over 850ms var(--ease); opacity 0 to 1 over 600ms; items entering together cascade in reading order by data-stagger (100ms default, rows 40ms, wells 60ms, capped 600ms); once at threshold .18; transitions released after arrival (.rv-done); if the script never runs, everything shows after 2.5s
motion.purpose: One grammar for everything that arrives on the home page.

motion.name: tile-settle
motion.value: screen scale(1.05) to 1 over 800ms var(--ease); arrow button opacity 0 to 1, scale(.8) to 1, arrow rotate(45deg) to 0, 450ms
motion.purpose: Tile hover and focus on fine pointers (altastudio.framer.website's image settle).

motion.name: experiment-open
motion.value: description grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr, 500ms var(--ease); text opacity 350ms and translateY(-6px) to 0; wash opacity 0 to 1 and scale(.985) to 1, 500ms; siblings opacity .16 and blur(3px), 300ms
motion.purpose: Experiments open on hover and keyboard focus; the row grows downward only.

motion.name: row-lean
motion.value: title translateX(6px) 450ms var(--ease); date to Ink 300ms; group siblings opacity .55 400ms; press scale(.985)
motion.purpose: Record rows, pagers and profile rows.

motion.name: preview-spring
motion.value: from translateY(-100%) scale(.2) blur(15px) radius 99px to translateY(-50%) scale(1) blur(0) radius 24px over 750ms cubic-bezier(.22, .61, .36, 1); leaves with opacity 0 and blur(5px) over 300ms; the record aside steps back to .14 and blur(4px)
motion.purpose: Row previews at one fixed place (hasque.com's spring-in).

motion.name: well-lift
motion.value: translateY(-2px) with the lift shadow, 450ms var(--ease)

motion.name: window-light
motion.value: --mx/--my eased toward pointer at 6% per frame; --my clamped -20% to 60%; returns to 50%/0% on leave
motion.purpose: The light in the window follows the pointer.

motion.name: static
motion.value: canvas at one grain per CSS pixel, redrawn every frame from four 512px noise tiles at random offsets; opacity .1; normal blend
motion.purpose: The grain over every page (hasque.com's measure).

motion.name: bottom-edge
motion.value: eight backdrop layers blur .3/1.3/2.8/5/7.8/11.3/15.3/20px with saturate(.85) each, masks starting 8.75% lower each, over a fade to the ground (clear at the top, 55% at 45%, 92% at the foot); opacity = remaining scroll / 160px
motion.purpose: The progressive blur at the foot of the screen (neiden.framer.media's measure, desaturating instead of saturating so colour sinks into the dark).

motion.name: page-change
motion.value: old root: opacity 1 to 0 and scale(.985) blur(6px), 340ms; new root: opacity 0 to 1, 340ms, and translateY(12px) to 0, 520ms; menu group 520ms; pill-mark group 560ms; fallback: body opacity 0 over 220ms before leaving, main rises in over 480ms
motion.purpose: Cross-document view transitions with a fade fallback.

motion.name: bob
motion.value: 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; translateY 0 to 8px; opacity .5 to 1
motion.purpose: The scroll arrow in the window.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: reveal, static refresh, bob, pointer light, settle, unfold and lean transitions, preview spring, smooth scrolling and page changes all off

drift: Two small lifts (the tile arrow 0 8px 20px .25 and the pill 0 10px 25px .15) sit outside the declared object-shadow-plus-window scale.
Radii 12px, 16px and 24px are written as literals in several rules rather than through --r-btn / --r-win; the active tab bar uses a one-off 2px radius.
Two traffic-light palettes: the window dots (#f46b5d #f9bd4e #57c353) and the drawn Mac bar (#ff5f57 #febc2e #28c840).
Inline pixel overrides in markup: max-width 620px / 640px on tile devices, margin-top 8px on the hockey facts, max-width 640px on the contact rows.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "One Lit Window"**

One person in a dim room, lit by one screen. The ground is near-black under a film of fine animated static, with a single soft light falling from the top of every page and a progressive blur where the room meets the bottom of the screen. Into that room the home page sets one glass-barred window that introduces him by name, with one plain line about what he does, his portrait and a live clock; everything after it is the record: four colour tiles in the colours of the screens they hold, an italic index of small experiments that open when you reach for them, five sentences over dated rows beside interests and This fall, and a giant wordmark to close. The other ten pages are sheets: one 640px column in the same room. Pages change by cross-fading in place: the old page steps back and softens, the new one rises, the menu holds still and the current tab's mark slides.

The material is glass, grain and light rather than paper and card. Depth comes from blur, alpha and light, not from borders or drop shadows on content. Colour is rationed: one white at three strengths does all the reading, hairlines sit at 10% white, one red marks the email, and saturated colour appears only where a real screen supplies it or as a soft wash behind an experiment. Hover settles, leans and steps back; nothing tilts.

Density is generous everywhere: 176px between sections, 80px between record groups. No numbers stand on the landing; they wait on the pages that explain them. The build refuses the hero slogan, a stat wall, buttons, and the card grid.
keyCharacteristics: Ground #0d0d0f under 10% static, one grain per CSS pixel, a new field every frame; a top radial light; an eight-layer progressive blur on the bottom edge that fades out as the page ends.
The hero is his name in Switzer 600 with the three-layer glow, then a 20px introduction whose first sentence is in full ink.
Colour from real screens (paper, gold, blue, sand) and, as light only, two wash colours for experiments; one red for the email.
Radii 44 / 24 / 16 / 12 / pill; one long soft object shadow, plus the window's own and two small lifts.
One reveal grammar on the translate property (rise and fade, 850ms), cascading in reading order; hover settles, leans and dims; nothing tilts.
Cross-document view transitions between pages with a fade fallback; every page reads without JavaScript, rests under reduced motion, and prints white.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: Saturated colour enters the room only as the colour of a real screen or object being shown (a product's colour on its tile, a photograph inside a device), or as a soft wash of light behind an opened experiment. The site's own palette is ground, ink at three strengths, hairline, well and one red.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Text is set in Ink, Ink 2 or Ink 3 and nothing else. Hierarchy is carried by alpha and size, never by a fourth grey or a coloured heading.

rules.name: The Red Is a Mark Rule
rules.body: Red appears on words and strokes, at most a few per screen: an address, a selection. It never fills a button, a tile, or a background.

rules.name: The One Word Rule
rules.body: Each sheet's title or dek carries exactly one phrase in Instrument Serif italic, set slightly larger than the surrounding Switzer. The serif never sets body copy or a label; its other homes are the paper tile's title and the experiments' titles. The hero, being his name, carries none.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only where the content is a reading: the clock. Never for prose, headings, labels or navigation.

rules.name: The Tighter As It Grows Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens with size: -.01em at 14 to 20px, -.02em at 20 to 22px, -.035em at 44 to 96px, -.06em on the wordmark; the 12px running head opens to +.08em.

rules.name: The Light Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth on content is made with alpha washes, hairlines and blur. Drop shadows belong to objects (devices, pages, previews, the window) and to a well only while it is lifted; never to rows, tiles or text blocks at rest.

rules.name: The Glow Is the Name Rule
rules.body: The three-layer glow exists for the display name. Other large type gets at most the faint title halo.

dos: Do introduce him by name on the landing, in plain Switzer with the glow, and let one factual line say what he does.
Do set every sheet title with exactly one phrase in Instrument Serif italic, about 6% larger than the Switzer around it.
Do take colour from the screen being shown: set --tile to the product's own colour and put the screenshot inside a drawn device or a white page with the object shadow.
Do keep numbers on the pages that explain them, each with its caveat beside it; the landing carries none.
Do use the five radii as nested scales: 44px tile, 24px ring, wells, previews and washes, 16px inner frame, 12px rows and small objects, full pill for controls.
Do keep hover as settle, lean and step back, and give the keyboard the same state.
Do put the reveal class on the object that arrives and let things that arrive together cascade.
Do keep the whole page legible with JavaScript off and at rest under prefers-reduced-motion; provide a white print sheet for anything a reader would print.
donts: Don't put a slogan or a statistic in the hero; the halo of the first screen belongs to the person.
Don't introduce a fourth text colour or a coloured heading.
Don't fill any surface with red, or use it for more than a handful of words on a screen.
Don't set the three-layer glow on anything other than the display name.
Don't put drop shadows on rows, tiles or text; shadows belong to devices, pages, previews, the window, and a well only while lifted.
Don't use JetBrains Mono for anything but the clock.

Don't animate padding, margin or height for an opening; the one layout property the site animates is grid-template-rows (0fr to 1fr) for the row being opened; everything else moves with transform, translate and opacity.
Don't put a small uppercase label (an eyebrow) above a heading or a title.
